Issue 1247: Keep numeric_range consistent with the items it produces

numeric_range produces its items by repeated multiplication, but derived len(), __contains__ and index() from division by the step. With floats the two disagree, so a range could report a length that did not match what it yielded, and could deny membership to its own items.
